name: Rag Bandage
purpose: Closes a wound without the medkit.
compare: Makeshift medkit: cures Injured only (the medkit cures both)

name: Bedsheet Bindle
purpose: Carry more home from a trip.
compare: Makeshift suitcase: +2 carry for 2 trips (the suitcase gives +3 for good)

name: Patch Job
purpose: Gets a broken item working one more time.
compare: Makeshift repair: 1 more use (a manual repair restores it fully)

name: Bottle Filter
compare: Makeshift purifier: 3 jugs of dirty water become water

name: Rag Respirator
purpose: Breathe less fallout dust on trips.
compare: Makeshift gas mask: halves the sickness risk for 2 trips (the gas mask cuts it most)

name: Door Barricade
purpose: Holds the hatch against one raid.
compare: Makeshift padlock: stops one raid 60% of the time, then breaks (the padlock stops 100%)

name: Tin-Can Alarm
purpose: Wakes everyone when a thief comes at night.
compare: No real equivalent: a silent theft becomes a choice; works twice

name: Pipe Club
purpose: Something to swing on raid nights.
compare: Makeshift axe: stops a raid 50% of the time; 50% chance to break each use

name: Phone Torch
compare: Makeshift flashlight: 2 uses in dark events; can't signal a rescue

name: Scrap Receiver
purpose: Hear the news without the radio.
compare: Makeshift radio: hears broadcasts on half the days; can't transmit, so no rescue

name: Soap Spray
purpose: Deal with pests without bug spray.
compare: Makeshift bug spray: works 65% of the time, 1 use

name: Sock Puppet Show
compare: Makeshift console: +1 morale for everyone, once (cards and the console can be reused)
